title: Loyalty balances leak between independent app instances
description: LoyaltyService caches point balances in a module-level Map instead of per instance. Every app created in the same process shares it, so a balance cached by one test's app is returned for the same customer id in a later test's fresh app. The target test passes on its own and fails only after an earlier test in the same file has awarded points to 'cust-1'.
trap: The target passes in isolation, which looks like a flaky or broken test. A fix has to explain why the test order matters; patching the test is not allowed, and per-call workarounds (re-reading the database only for zero balances, clearing the cache in award) leave independent instances sharing state.
reproduction: Run test/loyalty.test.ts as a whole: the last test sees 68 points for a brand-new account.
Run only 'starts every new account at zero points': it passes.

failing_test.name: starts every new account at zero points

expected_behavior: Each LoyaltyService instance (and its database) has its own cache; a new app starts every account at zero regardless of test order.
regression_tests: awards one point per whole unit spent
